description:
Make each built-in validation gate checker compute the one report over its captured image and report the selection the plan's `checker-selections` contract assigns it, deleting the checkers' private pipelines.

## Background

- Dispatch: `execute_builtin_checker_with_repository_view` (`crates/jit/src/commands/gate_check.rs:1032-1227`). The issue checker calls `captured_issue_rule_report` (`:450-518`), the label-target checker `captured_scope_rule_report` (`:520-601`), and both call `repository_rule_report` (`:440-448`), a full repository validation, only to keep its dangling-link and drift findings. The rule checker calls `rule_validation_report` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1063-1137`), whose other caller, the CLI rule view, already selects from the report.
- The label-target checker evaluates graph rules over the scope slice (`evaluate_graph_scoped`, `gate_check.rs:574`); the issue checker keeps every configuration error of a rule matching the issue (`:502-505`).
- Built-in checker faults record `error` runs, while findings about repository content record `failed`.
- Tests that re-prove filtering: `gate_check.rs:2890` (`test_repository_validation_warns_for_sorted_placeholder_gate_keys`, which calls `review_placeholder_findings`), `:2917,2942` (label target), `:2972,3071` (rule validation); `run_rules(None)` comparisons at `:2839,3042`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: Each of the repository, issue, rule and label-target checkers computes one report over its image and converts the selection the contract assigns it; `repository_rule_report`, `captured_issue_rule_report`, `captured_scope_rule_report` and `rule_validation_report` no longer exist.
- [hard] REQ-02: One harness test shows, for one image and each checker kind, that the checker's findings equal the findings `jit validate` reports for the same selection.
- [hard] REQ-03: A run's status keeps the fault classification: a configuration fault such as an unloadable rule set records `error`, and a content finding records `failed`.
- [hard] REQ-04: The listed checker tests are reduced to that wiring or removed where the selection tests own the property, and they no longer call the executor's placeholder pass or `run_rules`.

## Notes

- Behaviour changes: the label-target checker evaluates rules over the whole repository, so coverage children and dependency targets outside the target's subtree count; the issue checker's configuration errors narrow to the gated issue's subject or rule; the issue checker reports the `rules-file` finding for an unloadable rule set, as `jit validate <id>` does.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Built-in validation gate checkers select from the report
